metadata.description: Validation test for failsafe AUTO-LAND (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T09): after a climb, in a 3 m/s north wind, the link is lost at 10 s. Stage 2 at 11.5 s runs Altitude Hold, which arrests the stage-1 drop, descends under control and lands; the quad disarms 60 s into stage 2. Phase 11 adds Position Hold.
